title: Cross-functional roadmap gates and dependency contracts
creator: Marco Sánchez
description:
Problem: Cross-team dependencies on roadmap deliverables are causing late integration surprises and missed launch criteria. Current trackers are ad-hoc (spreadsheets + issue links) and lack a lightweight contract that captures owner, acceptance, fallbacks, and readiness signals at agreed gates.

Objective: Design and deliver a lightweight 'Roadmap Gate' pattern and templates for PM/Eng/Design/Security/Infra that will be used in quarterly planning and cycle handoffs. The gate enforces a dependency contract that includes: owner, interface spec, readiness checklist, SLA/fallback plan, and automated readiness signal surfaced in the Console signalboard.

Scope:
- Create Roadmap Gate template for Linear issues and a corresponding Confluence playbook.
- Implement a dependency contract checklist with machine-readable readiness fields (status, blockers, expected delivery window, fallback).
- Prototype an export that surfaces gate readiness in the Roadmap Dashboard (signal column) and Console signalboard.
- Run a pilot across two cross-functional initiatives (Serving Runtime and Console).

Out of scope: automated enforcement in CI, full backend integration to Console (only prototype surface), and org-wide rollout (pilot only).

Why this matters: Reduces last-minute scope slips, improves cross-team planning fidelity, and provides an auditable handoff artifact for regulated customers. Helps tracks OKR progress by making dependency readiness visible to stakeholders and execs.

Deliverables:
1) Linear Roadmap Gate issue template and example issues for pilot initiatives.
2) Confluence playbook describing roles, gate timeline (T-6, T-3, T-0), and escalation playbook.
3) A lightweight JSON schema for readiness signal (used by exports).
4) Pilot retrospective noting friction, measurement, and recommended rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Linear template exists and is used to create Roadmap Gate issues for two pilot initiatives
Confluence playbook approved by PM, ENG, Design, Security, Infra leads
Readiness signal prototype updates Roadmap Dashboard with gate state (green/amber/red)
Pilot retrospective includes measurable improvement in pre-launch blockers (target: 30% reduction)
